task: Review cash realization and funding evidence before a portfolio rebalance
method: Local Node.js CLI, no API key or paid provider; deterministic shared browser/Node calculation

mcp.outputPolicy: Compact tool summary; complete packet via local resources/read. Last 8 packets cached until process exit. Save evidence separately.
mcp.scope: Local selected archive. Not a hosted broker integration.

financialReview: Existing reviewed annotations only; source collection does not approve changed bytes.

output.inputs: Exact previous/current snapshot text and SHA-256
output.baselineMode: Saved snapshot or reconstruction from the current archive
output.report: Per-company thesis status, changes, cash calculations, historical cash bridges and liquidity where reviewed, exact inputs, source checks, forward funding unknowns and limits

privacy: Requests and notes stay local. No positions, weights, account identifiers or automatic reporting. Do not send notes to a remote model unless separately authorized.
trust: Pin release and packet hashes independently. Hashes prove consistency, not source truth or what a model consumed.

license.issuerSources: Linked, not redistributed; original rights retained
